name: panel
title: Panel
description: Manga page layout. PanelGrid is the page (a CSS grid with gutters; cols, rows, gap, reading="rtl" for right-to-left panel order). Panel is a case placed on it (colSpan, rowSpan) with a 3px outline drawn in SVG, so a side can be cut on a slant (cut={{ side: "start" | "end", size }} in px; give the neighbour the opposite cut and the gutter stays parallel); ink panels for night scenes. PanelCaption is the narration box, a 2px case in a corner. Compose with SpeedLines, Screentone, SpeechBubble and Sfx.

meta.tagline: A page grid, slanted cuts and narration boxes.
meta.usage:
import { Panel, PanelCaption, PanelGrid } from "@/components/manga/panel"

<PanelGrid cols={3} rows={2} className="aspect-[4/3]">
  <Panel colSpan={2} rowSpan={2}>…</Panel>
  <Panel cut={{ side: "start" }}>
    <PanelCaption>Midnight.</PanelCaption>
  </Panel>
  <Panel>…</Panel>
</PanelGrid>

props.name: reading
props.description: On PanelGrid: panel order; defaults to the page setting (data-reading on <html>).

props.name: cut
props.description: On Panel: slanted side, size in px (default 32).

props.name: ink
props.description: On Panel: ink background, paper lines.
